meta.title: Funded Economics Master's & PhD Programs Tracker
meta.coverage_note: Master's and PhD programs in Economics across Europe, Asia, and Australia that offer some form of funding (scholarship, stipend, tuition waiver, or assistantship). Started as a curated seed list, not an exhaustive census; grows and refreshes over periodic automated passes.

programs.name: Research Master in Economics
programs.repec_rank: Not ranked standalone (joint institute). Affiliates: VU Amsterdam #47, U. Amsterdam #52, Erasmus Rotterdam #56
programs.other: Strong quantitative background; max. 35 students/year; feeds into PhD at UvA/VU/Erasmus
programs.deadline: 1 Dec (scholarship/non-EEA) / 1 Feb (partner non-EEA & EEA scholarship) / 1 May (EEA) — recurring; confirm 2027 dates
programs.funding_detail: Scholarships via University of Amsterdam and Tinbergen Institute; apply in December round for best funding chance. Amounts not published.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026; verify deadlines for 2027 cohort

programs.name: Doctoral Program
programs.other: ~5 year program; check Admissions section + Student Handbook for full requirements
programs.deadline: Not specified on this page — check Admissions section
programs.funding_detail: Doctoral school ensures PhD funding; TA/RA positions available. Some M2-level scholarships/grants too.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026; needs deeper check of Admissions subpage

programs.name: Doctoral Programme in Economics
programs.other: Highly competitive; EU + associate country focus
programs.start: 1 September (2026-27 cohort already started; next intake Sept 2027)
programs.deadline: ~15 January (recurring annual pattern; 2026-27 cycle deadline was 15 Jan 2026 — 2027-28 date TBA)
programs.progfee: Funded candidates pay no tuition; self-funded fee not disclosed
programs.funding_detail: EUI contracting states (25 EU + Norway/Switzerland) grants; Italian MFA grants for 14 countries; EUI Special Doctoral Fellowships; external scholarship options.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026; watch for 2027-28 deadline announcement

programs.name: Combined M.Sc. Economic Research / Doctoral Program
programs.other: Cambridge CAE also accepted in place of IELTS/TOEFL
programs.deadline: 15 January (recurring annual) — 2026 cycle already closed; next expected ~15 Jan 2027
programs.funding_detail: Grant/scholarship application process; GRE + 2 references required to be considered for scholarship and conditional PhD offer.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026

programs.name: PhD in Economics
programs.other: Cambridge Advanced/Proficiency also accepted; exemptions for English-speaking background
programs.deadline: Recurring pattern: opens ~11 Nov, funding cutoff ~31 Jan, final ~31 May — the 2025-26 cycle (for Sept 2026 start) already closed 31 May 2026; next cycle expected to open ~Nov 2026
programs.funding_detail: Scholarships and/or tuition waivers on academic-merit basis, all nationalities. Apply by funding deadline (~31 Jan) for consideration.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026; verify current-cycle dates directly

programs.name: Master's in Economics
programs.gre: Optional/recommended (Economics track); required for PhD Track (BSE code 2531)
programs.other: Duolingo 120 min; Cambridge 180 min (B2-C2); 2 references (academic preferred)
programs.deadline: 15 January (full funding consideration; applications accepted after) — 2026-27 intake round already closed; next round ~Jan 2027 for 2027-28 intake
programs.funding_detail: ~EUR 550,000 awarded annually across all Masters; ~24% of students get full/partial funding. Tuition waivers of 25/50/75/100%. Named scholarships: Ramon Areces Foundation, UniCredit Foundation (100% tuition).
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026

programs.name: PhD Program
programs.other: Applications submitted BY a prospective PSE supervisor, not directly by candidate. Requires prior completion of APE, EP, or PPD Master's. Full-time, in-person, taught in English.
programs.deadline: Not specified — tied to supervisor/funding availability, not a fixed calendar date
programs.funding_detail: Distinctive model: 'Only candidates with secured funding are admitted' — funding must be arranged before/at admission, typically via the feeder Master's program.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026; unusual application model, needs manual follow-up

programs.name: PhD Programme in Economics
programs.ielts: Not required for native speakers / English-taught higher degrees; otherwise recommended
programs.other: Referees must submit by first week of February
programs.deadline: 1 December – 31 January recurring window — the round for 2026/27 entry already closed 31 Jan 2026; next round expected ~Dec 2026–Jan 2027
programs.funding_detail: 4 years full financing: mix of tax-free scholarships, taxable scholarships, and time-limited university employment. Entrance salary ~24,000 SEK/month net (2024 rate). Dept assists with external funding too.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026

programs.name: MPhil + DPhil in Economics
programs.gre: Required unless UK/Ireland degree <5 yrs old; competitive ~160V/164Q/4.5AW
programs.other: C1 Advanced also accepted (191 overall, 185/component); tests valid within 2 years of course start
programs.deadline: Closed for 2026-27 entry; ~January annual deadline pattern — register for 2027-28 notification
programs.funding_detail: 1,100+ full/partial graduate scholarships for 2026-27, merit-based. Automatic consideration for most scholarships if course offer received by January deadline.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026; watch for 2027-28 cycle opening

programs.gre: Not specified — check admission requirements page

programs.name: PhD in Economics and Finance
programs.other: 42nd cycle referenced for 2026-27; check 'Preparing to Apply' subpage for full requirements
programs.deadline: Ordinary cycle ~October (closed); special FIS-funded call ~18 May 2026 — confirm annual pattern
programs.funding_detail: Standard funded positions in ordinary admissions cycle, plus a dedicated FIS (Fondo Italiano per la Scienza) funded call seen for 2026.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026

programs.name: Economics MRes + MPhil/PhD
programs.ielts: Not specified on this page (UCL 'Level 2' proficiency required)
programs.gre: Required (except UCL Economics MSc grads/current students)
programs.other: Prep English courses available via UCL for international students
programs.deadline: ~20 Oct – 13 Jan recurring window (dates shown were for Oct 2026 entry, already closed) — next application window expected to open ~Oct 2026 for Oct 2027 entry
programs.progfee: Full-time GBP 31,300 / Part-time GBP 15,650 (2026/27; same UK & international)
programs.funding_detail: Wolfson Postgraduate Scholarship (Full fees + stipend) — closed for 2026/27, check next round. Additional funding via department and UCL scholarships portal.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026

programs.name: PhD in Economics
programs.other: Non-English-medium graduates may need to take a Graduate English Course
programs.deadline: Early: 30 September 2026; Main: 1 December 2026 (recurring annual pattern, applied to the upcoming cycle)
programs.funding_detail: Full financial support (fees + living expenses) for 5 years: NUS Research Scholarship (years 1-4), department funding (year 5), plus research/travel allowance.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026; contact econ-phd@nus.edu.sg for specifics

programs.other: Conditional offers require official documents by end of July
programs.deadline: 1 December 2026 (recurring annual pattern, applied to the upcoming cycle)
programs.funding_status: Likely (via HKPFS / dept funding — see ASA-03)
programs.funding_detail: Not detailed on this page directly — cross-reference Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (ASA-03) and department stipends.

programs.name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS)
programs.uni: Hong Kong universities incl. CUHK / HKUST / HKU / CityU (Economics eligible)
programs.repec_rank: Varies by host university (scheme spans multiple HK institutions)
programs.ielts: Not specified in scheme rules (set by individual dept/program)
programs.toefl: Not specified in scheme rules (set by individual dept/program)
programs.gre: Not specified in scheme rules (set by individual dept/program)
programs.other: Apply via 2 parallel channels: RGC website (choose up to 2 programmes) AND university's own online system, quoting HKPFS reference number. Selection on academic excellence, research potential, communication, leadership.
programs.deadline: 1 December 2026, 12:00 noon HKT (RGC) / 11:59pm HKT (university, e.g. CUHK)
programs.funding_detail: ~HK$1.81 million total (~US$232,400): stipend HK$344,400/yr (~US$44,200), conference/travel HK$14,400/yr, tuition waiver up to HK$198,000, lodging award up to HK$100,000, first-year hostel waiver.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026; this is a cross-institution scheme, not a single program — apply through chosen university's Economics dept

programs.gre: Not mandatory, but scores considered if submitted; recommended for non-Singapore-university degree holders

programs.deadline: Not specified on this page — contact ac-sss-ge@ntu.edu.sg
programs.funding_detail: MOE-subsidised programme; Nanyang Research Scholarship available for qualifying students.
programs.notes: Seed entry Aug 2026; deadline needs manual confirmation
